_about: Curated core rules and guidelines (ADR-062): documents officials cite daily that are not (only) on Shasanadesh. Every entry is reviewed by hand: official page, direct PDF (HTTPS), issuer, jurisdiction, edition. Ingest with `npm run ingest:source -- core-rules`. Add entries here; never crawl.
